name: Kugawa Marika
source: A third-year student and one of the most recognized names at your school. Class president and member of the school’s gymnastics club, she has excellent reflexes and does very well academically, though you’d do well not to mention her short stature. She’s soft-spoken and a bit of an airhead, but pulls through when the situation demands it.
